Experience working in a community college, K-12, or other educational environment

Establish and maintain effective working relationships with individuals from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnic, and lived-experience backgrounds

items.item_text: For questions regarding this position, please contact the Human Resources Department at hr@frc.edu .
Visa Sponsorship
H1B1 visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university;

Establish and maintain effective working relationships with individuals from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnic, and lived-experience backgrounds
One (1) year of experience in advising, outreach, education support, TRIO programs, student services, youth development, recruitment, or related student-focused services;
Experience working in a community college, K-12, or other educational environment
Communicate effectively and respectfully with individuals from varied backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives
An equivalent combination of education and experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the position.
Experience working with TRIO, college readiness, outreach, or educational access programs
Experience working with diverse student populations, including first-generation, low-income, historically underserved, disproportionately impacted, or nontraditional student populations
Experience conducting outreach, workshops, presentations, or educational engagement activities
Experience utilizing student information systems, databases, educational technologies, website content tools, or digital communication platforms

Provide advising support, guidance, and information regarding educational opportunities, college readiness, financial aid, admissions processes, academic preparation, career exploration, and available support services within established guidelines
Assist participants with navigating postsecondary preparation, admissions, financial aid, enrollment, and related educational support processes

Support equitable access to programs, services, and resources for students and participants from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnic, and educational backgrounds
Provide culturally responsive communication and student support practices that promote student engagement, educational access, college readiness, persistence, and educational success
Assist participants in identifying educational, career, financial aid, transfer, and support service resources appropriate to individual needs and goals
Refer participants to appropriate schools, colleges, counselors, faculty, support programs, community resources, and external agencies as needed
Coordinate and support workshops, orientations, campus visits, presentations, educational activities, outreach events, and student engagement activities
Assist in outreach and engagement efforts designed to increase participation and educational access for historically underserved and disproportionately impacted student populations
Support implementation of ETS/TRIO program activities and student support initiatives in accordance with applicable grant requirements and institutional procedures
Maintain regular communication and follow-up with participants, families, schools, and community partners to support educational engagement and program participation
Monitor and track participant eligibility, participation, services, academic progress information, and related program activities in accordance with grant and reporting requirements
Maintain accurate electronic and physical records, documentation, case notes, participation records, and related program data
Compile, track, monitor, and prepare reports related to assigned activities, participation, student services, and operational requirements
Develop and maintain outreach, advising, workshop, presentation, and informational materials using print, presentation, website, and digital communication platforms
Utilize student information systems, databases, spreadsheets, communication systems, and related technologies to support assigned activities and operational needs
Collaborate with faculty, staff, administrators, schools, families, community organizations, and external partners to support coordinated educational access and student success initiatives
Foster welcoming, respectful, inclusive, and student-centered interactions with students, families, employees, and community members
Maintain confidentiality of participant and student information in accordance with FERPA and applicable laws, regulations, District policies, and grant requirements
Participate in meetings, trainings, professional development activities, committees, and shared governance activities as assigned
May provide lead direction to student assistants, peer mentors, tutors, or temporary staff
Perform related duties as assigned
Principles and practices of student support services, outreach, college readiness programs, advising support, and educational access initiatives
Willingness to work occasional evenings, weekends, or off-site activities in support of assigned programs and student services
College admissions, financial aid, enrollment, transfer, and postsecondary educational processes
Applicable policies, procedures, regulations, confidentiality requirements, and FERPA requirements related to student records and support services
Basic operational requirements and reporting practices associated with ETS/TRIO and grant-funded educational support programs
Principles of culturally responsive communication, equitable student engagement, and inclusive student support practices
Student support strategies designed to promote educational access, persistence, retention, and success for diverse student populations
Outreach, workshop coordination, presentation, and student engagement practices
Recordkeeping, reporting, data tracking, and file maintenance practices
Standard office software, databases, student information systems, website content tools, social media communication tools, and digital communication platforms
Principles of effective communication, customer service, and interpersonal interaction
Correct English usage, grammar, spelling, punctuation, and business correspondence
Provide guidance, information, outreach, and student support services within established procedures and guidelines
Assist participants with navigating postsecondary preparation, admissions, financial aid, enrollment, and educational support processes
Support inclusive and equitable student engagement and service delivery practices that promote educational access and student success
Coordinate workshops, outreach activities, presentations, campus visits, orientations, and student support activities
Organize, prioritize, and manage multiple assignments, activities, deadlines, and operational processes with attention to detail
Interpret and explain policies, procedures, deadlines, eligibility requirements, and program guidelines
Maintain accurate records, documentation, reports, and program data
Utilize databases, spreadsheets, student information systems, and related technologies effectively
Develop and maintain informational, outreach, and presentation materials
Exercise sound judgment, professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality in handling sensitive information
Adapt to changing priorities, operational needs, technologies, regulations, and student service requirements
Work independently within established guidelines and collaboratively as part of a team
Ability to travel locally and regionally as required by the assignment
Demonstrated ability to support inclusive and equitable student engagement and educational success initiatives
Demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students
